lines.text: Many learners say: I am agree with you.
Agree already has the action. Do not add am.

data.why: Agree already has the action. Do not add am.

native.tip: En español decimos “estoy de acuerdo” con “estar”, pero en inglés “agree” ya es verbo: se dice “I agree”, sin “am”.
native.caption: 🙅 Error común: “I am agree with you.” En inglés no se usa “am” con “agree”: “I agree with you.” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.

en.tip: In Spanish you say “estoy de acuerdo,” but in English “agree” is already a verb, so you say “I agree,” with no “am.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “I am agree with you.” In English you do not use “am” with “agree”: “I agree with you.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
